text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, at the Tracen Academy vegetable garden――

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Carrots here...? 
I-Is it really okay for someone like me?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! 
We would truly love to borrow your help as a member of the Beautification Committee, Nishino Flower-san!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: We were gifted seeds for a rare, highly nutritious variety, but apparently it is exceptionally delicate...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We wanted to entrust them to someone who will care for them with utmost tenderness. 
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: To place such trust in me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Understood! 
I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Advice for the garden? Yeah, leave it to me! 
First off, when it comes to root veggies, thoroughly tilling the soil is key.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Make sure to loosen it up real good so there aren't any clumps, at least down to elbow depth!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: About this deep, right! Understood!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hold on. With arms your size, Flower, you'd better go about one fist deeper. And next――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You mentioned wanting a reference for soil conditioning. I am certain this book will prove useful.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! 
Incredible... It's written in so much detail.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If the contents prove too difficult, feel free to ask me again. Plant life always responds faithfully so long as you spare no effort—that is their greatest virtue.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Patience and attentive care, right. 
I'm good at that, so leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All right. Just you wait, little carrots. 
I'll raise you into splendid carrots...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was because of the heavy rain yesterday.
I slept lightly and ended up waking up early.
Having no other choice, I went out for a walk to wake myself up—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Thank goodness! Everyone's safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for doing your best.
I'll be waiting for you to sprout...!
choice_data_list: You're working hard so early in the morning.
You're working hard so early in the morning!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah, Trainer-san?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... the rain was so heavy yesterday, so I was worried about the carrots planted here.
And besides—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Since I was entrusted with "this field," I wanted to take proper care of it.
choice_data_list: Is there something special about this field?
Is there something special about this field?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Well, at least it's special to me—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Back when I had just enrolled here, there was a day I woke up really early.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't wait until class started.
So, I decided to explore the academy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: With no one around, the academy felt so vast and quiet—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: When I thought about how I was going to do my best here from now on, even though I was excited, I felt a little anxious too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right then, I caught sight of an "older girl" working in this field!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: During such a quiet time when everyone else was still fast asleep, she was doing her best all by herself—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Looking at her back, it felt like she was teaching me that you just have to do what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No matter how anxious I might feel, all I need to do is work hard just like that "older girl."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ever since that day, that "older girl" has been my role model!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Just like that "older girl," I want to take good care of this field too...
choice_data_list: So that's why you're working so hard.
So that's why you're working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! I still have a long way to go, but I want to give it my all in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Nishino Flower doing her utmost to grow toward her aspiration filled my heart with warmth.
